recommendations: Keep immutable frozen primary outcomes; publish labeled diagnostic evaluation separately.

Do not attribute unknown restoration or unlogged changes to the model, harness, host or a human without source evidence.
Separate verified product behavior, observed report claims, execution evidence and provenance status.
For future cohorts instrument executed child processes or use per-action trusted event receipts; audit inline scope content before deletion.
Freeze full-scoring mutation controls including missing/fabricated evidence before future applications.
Treat null backend/model/tokens/cost as unrecoverable unknowns; report 144 applications in 12 contexts, no statistical superiority.
